task.name: place_doll_stapler_swap
task.description: Use the left arm to put the white and blue doll into the green plate, and use the right arm to put the stapler into the blue plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the white and blue doll.
2. Grasp the white and blue doll with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the green plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the white and blue doll into the green plate.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the stapler.
6. Grasp the stapler with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the blue plate.
8. Release the gripper to place the stapler into the blue plate.
